image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a converted van chassis) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a two-tone paint job with a red roof and upper section, and a lime-green lower body separated by a yellow stripe. It has a prominent front grille, large windshield with wipers, side mirrors, and visible wheels. There is text on the windshield and license plate area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van/minibus silhouette, distinct from full-size buses and standard cars.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible. Side windows are present, though partially obscured by the angle and reflections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A sliding door track/handle mechanism is visible on the side, indicating a mid-body entrance.
The panel lines and handle on the side indicate a sliding door typical of this vehicle class.
The short hood and grille placement confirm a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame/occluded by the viewing angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a distinct multi-color livery (red/green/yellow) which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible front wheel matches the size and style of a commercial van/minibus.
The overall scale and window configuration suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the windshield destination board and the front license plate is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear characters.
Slight softness and lack of sharp mechanical definition in the side mirror assembly and door handle area; edges blend slightly into the background.
The grille slats and bumper line show very slight warping/inconsistency in perspective, though not structurally catastrophic.
